{{Navbar-Global Gas Infrastructure Tracker}}
'''Monument Pipeline''' is an operating natural gas pipeline in the United States.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001506307/000150630726000085/kmi-20260630.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://naturalgasintel.com/news/kmi-acquiring-monument-pipeline-for-505m-expanding-texas-natural-gas-reach/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Location==
The pipeline runs from Katy hub, Texas to Houston Ship Channel and Galveston County (La Porte, League City), Texas.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://naturalgasintel.com/news/kmi-acquiring-monument-pipeline-for-505m-expanding-texas-natural-gas-reach/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>

==Project Details==
*'''Owner: '''Kinder Morgan Inc<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001506307/000150630726000085/kmi-20260630.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/news/2026/april/kinder-morgan-strikes-505-million-deal-for-houston-area-monument-pipeline|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Capacity: '''285,000 Mcf/d<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/news/2026/april/kinder-morgan-strikes-505-million-deal-for-houston-area-monument-pipeline|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Length: '''225 mi<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://pgjonline.com/news/2026/april/kinder-morgan-strikes-505-million-deal-for-houston-area-monument-pipeline|title=pgjonline.com|website=pgjonline.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://naturalgasintel.com/news/kmi-acquiring-monument-pipeline-for-505m-expanding-texas-natural-gas-reach/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
*'''Status: '''Operating<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001506307/000150630726000085/kmi-20260630.htm|title=sec.gov|website=sec.gov|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://naturalgasintel.com/news/kmi-acquiring-monument-pipeline-for-505m-expanding-texas-natural-gas-reach/|title=naturalgasintel.com|website=naturalgasintel.com|access-date=2026-11-04}}</ref>
